extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and LaTeX users preparing commutative diagrams for papers and books
extracted.subtask_description: A practical guide to choosing and using LaTeX packages for drawing commutative diagrams, comparing features, installation, engine compatibility, syntax, and production-quality issues. Intended to help authors pick a package appropriate to diagram complexity and publisher workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ease of use / simplicity
rubrics_metrics.description: How simple and straightforward the package's syntax is for producing typical/simple diagrams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd is so easy to use that it should be the first choice for the simple diagrams it can handle; array syntax is familiar to those used to array and makes simple diagrams easy; xymatrix and diagxy (XY-pic based) are the most complicated to use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Output / diagram quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The visual quality of produced diagrams (line/arrow rendering, alignment, font integration) suitable for final publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Except where noted, all packages except array can produce high quality diagrams. array produces poor-quality diagrams and is best confined to drafts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for diagonal and curved arrows
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package supports diagonal arrows and curved arrows (and how easily).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd: only rectangular diagrams (no diagonal arrows). diagrams: does not curve arrows. kuvio: lacks curved arrows. DCpic: greatest strength is curved arrows. xymatrix and diagxy (XY-pic) support curved arrows (e.g., \ar@/^/ and curvature dimensions). Some packages can introduce curved arrows by defining them using picture environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrow stretching to match labels (automatic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether horizontal/vertical arrows automatically stretch to accommodate arrow labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd: Arrows stretch to match long labels (examples and tricks given). diagrams: Arrows stretch to match long labels (lower arrow also stretched). kuvio: Arrows don’t stretch to match long labels — needs scaling. DCpic: Arrows do not stretch to match long labels. xymatrix: Arrows don’t automatically stretch to match long labels, but can be fixed manually by increasing column separation (\xymatrixcolsep) or manual adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrows adjust to large object sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether arrows stretch or contract to accommodate large node contents (object boxes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: array: some automatic adjustments. diagrams and kuvio: arrows stretch (or contract) to match large objects (sometimes need scaling for best results). DCpic: originally did not stretch to match large objects; documentation claims v4.1 adds this but only v4.0 was available. xymatrix: arrows do stretch/contract to match large objects but label placement may then be off (placement fixes given).

rubrics_metrics.name: Variety of arrow shapes and types
rubrics_metrics.description: The number and kinds of arrow styles available (hook, mapsto, monomorphism, epimorphism, dashed, dotted, double, implies, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagrams and xymatrix (XY-pic) support a great variety of arrows. DCpic supports a limited number of arrow types but lists several (solid, dash, injection, aplication, etc.). DCPic has only a small number of arrow types. kuvio and others provide many, but some commands may not work on particular systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Label placement options and rotation
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to place labels above/below/left/right/mid, control rotation with arrows, and choose label style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagrams: labels placed as superscripts/subscripts; option 'nohug' stops labels rotating with arrows. xymatrix: labels rotate with the arrow by default; use | to break an arrow; label-centering issues and fixes explained. DCpic: labelposition parameter (+1 = at right, -1 = at left); cannot have labels on both sides of an arrow. diagxy templates: |p| gives label position (above/below/left/right/mid) but templates may not support both-sides labeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Templates and higher-level constructs
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of pre-built templates (squares, pullbacks, triangles, Vtrianglepair, etc.) to create common diagram shapes quickly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagxy: offers many templates (square, Square, Vtrianglepair, pullback, iiixii, hSquares, etc.). diagxy templates like Square adjust for long labels and large objects (Square vs square). xymatrix/XY-pic: lower-level but powerful; diagxy is an add-on that contains templates built on XY-pic. DCpic uses coordinate-based syntax (good for complex diagrams once objects positioned).

rubrics_metrics.name: Object positioning model (matrix vs coordinate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether objects are placed by their position in a matrix/grid or by explicit coordinates, and the implications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: array, amscd, diagrams, xymatrix: use matrix/grid positions (rows/columns). DCpic and diagxy: position objects by explicit integer coordinates (good for complicated diagrams where object placement is fine-grained). DCpic: position specified by a pair of integers; diagxy: \node a(x,y)[A] style coordinates in units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of arbitrary diagonal spans / non-standard cell offsets
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to create diagonal arrows spanning arbitrary (x,y) cell offsets rather than fixed 2+2 movement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagrams: allow \ldTo(2,4) style arguments; kuvio: an arrow to object x columns right and y rows above invoked by \aTo(x,y); xymatrix: use repeated letters in \ar[rrrd] form to go multiple cells; diagxy templates use explicit <dx,dy> coordinates in morphism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual control of label centering on stretched arrows
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether and how one can center or fine-tune label position when arrows stretch or when automatic placement is undesirable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd: use phantom labels to align/stretch arrows and \minCDarrowwidth to set minimum arrow length; xymatrix: use ^- and _- or sequences like ^<<< to move labels; xymatrix can also use entrymodifiers fix for axis alignment when object centers cause misalignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global scaling and spacing controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of global commands or package options to change spacing/scale of diagrams (column separation, x-scaling, minimum arrow width).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd: \minCDarrowwidth to increase minimum horizontal arrow length. kuvio: \xscale to scale diagram horizontally. xymatrix: \xymatrixcolsep{...} to increase column separation. diagrams: package options like 'small' to reduce distances between objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility with TeX engines and output drivers
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package works with pdflatex/dvips/dvi/dvipdfm and any special driver requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagrams: produces high quality with pdflatex but not from dvi files or using dvipdfm; diagrams has 'noPostScript' option to allow MikTeX to produce dvi files for previewing. kuvio: uses specials recognized only by dvips, not pdflatex. DCpic: based on PicTeX/pictexwd; can be used via tex→dvi→ps→pdf. xymatrix (XY-pic): works with pdflatex when loaded appropriately. Check package docs for engine-specific notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation and availability (MikTeX / CTAN / bundled)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package is included in a standard TeX distribution (MikTeX) or must be installed separately and how easy that is.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Except where noted, each package is included in the standard large MikTeX installation and can be used without restriction; diagrams is not part of standard MikTeX and must be downloaded from the author's page; kuvio may be missing from some installations but can be fetched from CTAN mirrors; diagxy and others may need manual install (rename .tex to .sty and refresh file name database).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts and choosing a family
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential conflicts between multiple diagram packages and the recommendation to choose one family to avoid issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To avoid conflicts between the packages, the author produced the document in segments. For more complicated diagrams, because of possible conflicts, it is probably necessary to choose one of the remaining programs or the family based on XY-pic. Use one package family consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation and manual availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Existence and currency of manuals, tutorials, and examples for learning and troubleshooting the package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most packages have manuals on the web (diagrams manual dated, kuvio has 'Typesetting diagrams with kuvio.tex', xymatrix documentation embedded in XY-pic with tutorial links). Check author/homepage/CTAN for manuals and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance status and obsolescence
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package is actively maintained or obsolete (affects compatibility and reliability).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: kuvio hasn’t been revised since 1996 and may be considered obsolete; diagrams manual somewhat dated; DCpic documentation references versions (v4.1 claim) so check for latest available version.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource usage and performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package relies on resource-heavy backends (e.g., PicTeX) or has reputational performance issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DCpic is based on PicTeX, which 'has a reputation as a resource hog'; consider performance for very large/complex diagrams.

rubrics_metrics.name: License and usage restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Any special license terms, acknowledgements, or use restrictions imposed by the package author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagrams manual: permission granted for academic production subject to acknowledgement, using up-to-date version, and sending one copy of the book to the author; use by commercial organizations may be considered academic under narrow conditions; software may not be used for any military purpose under any circumstances. Always check package-specific license text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Syntax expressiveness and concision
rubrics_metrics.description: How expressive and concise the package syntax is for attaching arrows, labels, and specifying directions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: xymatrix: arrows specified with \ar@{shape}[dir] and hop letters (l,r,u,d) — compact but sometimes cryptic (e.g., \ar@{^{(}->}). diagrams/kuvio: syntax similar to array with direction prefixes and suffixes (e.g., \rTo^u_d); DCpic: different syntax using \obj and \mor with coordinate-based object placement; diagxy provides high-level morphism and template commands that can be succinct for common patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Label font size and style control
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to control the font size/style used for labels on arrows and nodes (scriptstyle, scriptsize, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: amscd: items inserted into arrow code appear in scriptstyle. diagrams: labelstyle=\scriptstyle option illustrated. DCpic: suggests shrinking labels (\scriptsize) to fit long labels. diagxy Square example shows use of \text{...} and empty labels to control spacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations on labels on both sides of an arrow
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether a package allows labels both above and below (or left and right) a single arrow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DCpic: It is not possible to have labels on both sides of an arrow. diagxy: 'It is not possible to have add labels both above and below an arrow.' (templates likewise restricted). xymatrix allows superscript and subscript on the same arrow, but other packages may not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to combine low-level and template approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package allows mixing coordinate/low-level control and higher-level templates to build complex diagrams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: diagxy: you can combine templates or use explicit \node/\arrow commands to build diagrams that don't fit templates. DCpic: once objects correctly placed, easy to add arrows. This flexibility is useful for diagrams that don't match standard templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher and production workflow suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the package is acceptable/useful for publishers' production environments and submission requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: XY-pic (xymatrix) seems to be becoming the standard for more complicated commutative diagrams among publishers (AMS FAQ recommends it); Xypic considered a core component of AMS production environment, so no need to include it among files to submit. Check publisher preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workarounds and common fixes
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of known fixes for common problems (axis alignment, label centering, TeX engine issues, Scientific Word quirks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: xymatrix: add \entrymodifiers={+!!<0pt,\fontdimen22\textfont2>} to fix axis alignment; amscd: use phantom labels or \minCDarrowwidth to equalize arrow lengths; kuvio: scale with \xscale to handle long labels; for SW, insert as arrays and rewrite later; encapsulate foreign code or input from a separate file to avoid SW translation issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility with Scientific Word/Workplace (SW)
rubrics_metrics.description: How well the package works within Scientific Word/Workplace and practical advice for SW users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SW fully supports only array; best strategy is to insert diagrams as arrays while writing and rewrite them using a different package before final printing. Only amscd comes installed with SW (v4.1); installing diagrams into SW involves copying diagrams.sty into SW directory; xy-pic may be hard to install in TrueTeX bundled with SW, but may work with pdflatex in v5.0. Save as 'Portable LaTeX' to avoid conflicts with tcilatex.tex.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robustness of specific arrow commands across systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether particular arrow commands reliably produce output on different systems or may be system-dependent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: kuvio: \rMapsto and \rDots produced nothing on the author's system. Some arrow commands or fonts may require specific options or fonts (e.g., kuvio option arrsy) and may produce garbage if not configured correctly; test commands on your system.
